Whether or not the Thunderbird Menu Bar is displayed depends on your Operating System.

{for win,linux}
For Windows and Linux users, there are two cases:
* For existing Thunderbird users, if the ''Menu Bar'' is missing, it is usually because it has been hidden accidentally.
* For new Thunderbird users starting in any version of Thunderbird released in November 2012 or later, the ''Menu Bar'' is hidden by default.
{/for}
{for mac}
For Mac users, it is not possible to hide the ''Menu Bar'', so Mac users always see the ''Menu Bar''.
{/for}

{for win,linux}
= Hidden Menu Bar =
If you're using any version of Thunderbird released in November 2012 or later, you now have a menu button on the top-right corner that takes the most common functions and puts them in one menu. For new Thunderbird users, the Menu Bar is hidden by default.
;[[Image:Menu Button]]
;[[Image:Menu Button Menu]]{/for}
{for win}
*To temporarily show the Menu Bar, just press the {key Alt} key.
{/for}
{for linux}
*To temporarily show the Menu Bar, hit the {key F10} key.
{/for}
{for win,linux}
* To have the Menu Bar shown all the time, right-click on an empty section of the Tab Strip and check {menu Menu Bar} in the pop-up menu.
;[[Image:View Menu Bar]]{/for}
